en.headline: Water supply cut at Upper Wong Tai Sin Estate after pipe burst
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department expects fresh water to resume by 3am on Friday after a burst on Wong Tai Sin Road closed a stretch of the road and diverted several bus routes.
body: A burst water pipe on Wong Tai Sin Road near Ma Chai Hang Road this afternoon cut fresh water supplies to the entire Upper Wong Tai Sin Estate, including its shopping centre.

Police received a report at about 2:16pm. The Water Supplies Department has deployed water wagons to areas outside Kai Sin House, Tat Sin House and Cheong Sin House, where residents have been queuing for temporary supplies. The department said on its website that supply is expected to resume at 3am on Friday.

The Transport Department said the section of Wong Tai Sin Road between Ma Chai Hang Road and Nga Tsin Wai Road remains closed in both directions. Kowloon Motor Bus routes 7M, 11C and 211, and Citybus route A23, are being diverted. Drivers were advised to use alternative routes, and traffic in the area is busy.

zh.headline: 黃大仙上邨爆水管全邨停水 料明凌晨三時恢復
zh.dek: 黃大仙道近馬仔坑道水管爆裂，黃大仙上邨包括商場暫停食水供應，水務署調派水車，運輸署封閉一段路面，多條巴士改道。
body: 今天下午約2時16分，黃大仙道近馬仔坑道發生水管爆裂，導致黃大仙上邨全邨包括商場位置暫停食水供應。
水務署已調派水車到啟善樓、達善樓及倡善樓對開，供居民領取臨時食水，現場有數十人排隊。署方網頁顯示，預計明天凌晨3時恢復供水。
運輸署表示，黃大仙道來回方向介乎馬仔坑道與雅竹街之間仍然封閉。九巴7M、11C及211線，以及城巴A23線須改道行駛。駕駛人士應考慮其他道路，現時該處交通繁忙。
